svg.aria-label: How EquityLens works: public data, exchange and regulator files, news feeds and your broker are fetched, analysed and tested, stored and checked, then shown on laptop or phone and sent to Telegram
svg.text: Public data, exchange and regulator files, news feeds and your broker flow in; get analysed, tested and checked; then land on your laptop, phone and Telegram.
stock tags · one story, all sources
one Python process · laptop or cloud
days add up to the month total
sectors add up to the total
no future data in any test
● phone: scan the QR in Settings
● first run downloads history by itself
RBI and Fed releases · each once
Your keys, holdings and Telegram token stay on your computer (or your own server). Only the sources above, Telegram (if alerts are on) and your AI provider (if used) are contacted.
